Name: Portable Holes
Author: LeFauxMatt
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ulr2XSt.png[/img]
Adds Craftable holes to the game.
The Crafting Recipe for Portable Holes unlocks at Mining level 10.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oszWv38.png[/img]
Portable Holes is safe to add/remove at any time. If you have any Portable Holes crafted, and you remove this mod, they will all revert to regular Stairs.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lG4kcA2.png[/img]
For ease of use, it is recommended to set config options from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[list]
[*][b]SoftFall[/b] - Prevent taking damage when jumping down a hole.
[*][b]UnlockAutomatically[/b] - Unlock the crafting recipe automatically.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fMhu2q8.png[/img]
See [url=https://github.com/LeFauxMatt/StardewMods/tree/develop/PortableHoles#translations]here[/url] for the current status on translations.

Feel free to visit me on my [url=https://lxnq.to/discord]Discord server[/url] for announcements and early access to beta releases of my mods.
You're also welcome to seek support or submit issues there. You can also find me on the Stardew Valley discord in #making-mods (LeFauxMatt#6785).
